53 traits now breed gradually

30,000 births checked all continuous anatomy and behavior fields. Without a mutation in that field, no child exceeded the normal ±3.5% range bound from its parents’ average. Derived walking speed combines several fields. Existing beetles retain their values. The 27 appearance loci retain actual inherited copies, including hidden colors and pattern surprises.

Large changes require a mutation in the affected field. Most mutation events are small; 5% use a larger effect. With 53 fields, the chance of a surprise somewhere is higher than the chance for any one field. Higher classroom mutation settings increase the frequency.

Fewer draws, with a visible decision

The legal radius fell from 205 to 160 model units. A ring-out wins immediately. At 60 seconds, or a simultaneous double exit, the closer beetle wins. Distances within 0.01 units tie; circles are guides, not point bins.

For the same 500 varied founder pairings, seeds and reversed corners: old rules drew 575 of 1,000 games; new rules drew 0 of 1,000. The new arena still reached the clock in 314 games; those were decided by center distance.

A separate 13,300-game current-arena audit included 20 controlled trait comparisons, strength/speed dose responses, 21 profile matchups, founders, descendants and 4,000 identical-genome corner controls. Those controls gave 2031 red wins, 1967 blue wins and 2 ties.

In 1,000 varied-founder games, the stronger beetle won 56.5% of comparable decisions; the faster beetle won 49.0%. Among descendants the figures were 52.0% and 46.3%. These are mixed-genome associations, not isolated causal effects.

Strength and speed alone do not guarantee victory. Some profiles remain more effective than others; equal trait totals do not imply equal value. Results describe finite samples of an invented game.

Movement and compatibility

Browser checks cover dragging and placing in both tanks, release and resumed movement, continued motion behind the inspector, explicit cooling, jar drops, opaque clues, and the concentric arena. Older SUMO2 and SUMO3 notebooks replay through preserved engines. Live shared-room create/join/start/read checks confirmed SUMO4 seeds, rejection of mixed rules, capability checks and denial of public table reads.

Reproduce with node --test tests/*.test.cjs, node tools/audit-gradual-and-center.cjs, and MATCH_SEEDS=100 RANDOM_MATCHES=1000 node tools/audit-battles.cjs. The raw data includes counts, seeds, all controlled comparisons and limits. No student data was used.
